title: Reflection of variable-ideal powers from punctured zero-section germs
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $d>0$, set $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], let $I=(X_1,\ldots,X_d)$ be the ideal generated by the variables, and let $z:\operatorname{Spec} A\to\operatorname{Spec} B$ be induced by constant coefficient [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $V$ be an open subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec} B$ whose inverse image under $z$ is the punctured spectrum $U=\operatorname{Spec} A\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$. Let $r:B\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ be restriction, $z_V:U\to V$ the restricted zero section, and for $x\in U$ let $g_x$ be the germ map into $\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}$ and $J_x=\ker(\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}\to\mathcal O_{U,x})$. For every $b\in B$ and every fixed $n\ge0$, if $g_x(r(b))\in J_x^n$ for all $x\in U$, then $b\in I^n$. This tests one global power series at one finite order.

proof.text: Transport the germ membership to the localized constant-coefficient map and then coefficientwise localize to A_p[[X]]. Denominators outside the zero-section prime have unit constant coefficient, so the localization extends. The kernel maps into the variables ideal, hence its nth power kills every coefficient of total degree less than n in A_p. The canonical stalk identifications give vanishing of the corresponding base coefficient germ.

For each low-degree coefficient, hV identifies the base points occurring in the hypothesis with every point away from the closed point. Punctured-function detection in a depth-two local ring makes that coefficient zero in A.

Apply the proved combined-ideal coefficient criterion with base ideal zero. Its low-degree coefficient conditions are zero, so b belongs to the nth variables-ideal power. This includes n=0 without a separate case.

theorem powerSeries_mem_variables_pow_of_punctured_germs
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let z := Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))
    let r := ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).inv ≫ V.ι.appTop).hom
    ∀ (b : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A) (n : ℕ),
      (∀ x : (z ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
        (V.toScheme.presheaf.Γgerm ((z ∣_ V) x)).hom (r b) ∈
          (RingHom.ker ((z ∣_ V).stalkMap x).hom) ^ n) →
      b ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPowerSeries.X (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) ^ n
